This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

135	### 4.2 feature 矩阵：Cargo.toml 如何决定二进制里有哪些模型线
136	
137	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
138	
139	一个关键问题：**为什么不是所有模型都编译进同一个二进制？**
140	
141	因为模型线的成本差异巨大：`qwen3` 是纯 Rust + CUDA，构建无需 Python；而 `qwen35` 需要构建期跑 Triton AOT（要装 Python + Triton），`glm52`/`k3` 需要 TileLang 生成 kernel，`kimi-k2`/`glm52` 还要额外的 CUDA 源码。把所有线无条件编译，意味着「只想跑 Qwen3 的用户」也得配齐整套工具链。
142	
143	Cargo 的 feature + optional dependency 机制正好解决这个问题：
144	
145	- 在 `[dependencies]` 里把各模型 crate 声明为 `optional = true`——默认不编译。
146	- 在 `[features]` 里为每条线开一个同名开关，开关激活时用 `dep:pegainfer-xxx` 把可选依赖「点亮」。
147	- `default = ["qwen3"]` 让默认构建只带 Qwen3，其他线按需 `--features` 拉入。
148	
149	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
150	
151	feature 激活的传导链：
152	
153	```text
154	cargo build --features gemma4
155	        │
156	        ▼  Cargo.toml [features]：gemma4 = ["dep:pegainfer-gemma4", "pegainfer-gemma4/gemma4"]
157	        │
158	        ├── dep:pegainfer-gemma4          → 可选依赖被点亮，模型 crate 参与编译
159	        └── pegainfer-gemma4/gemma4       → 把同名 feature 转发进模型 crate 内部，
160	                                            激活其内部门控的实现（kernel、构建脚本产物等）
161	        │
162	        ▼  src/main.rs 里 #[cfg(feature = "gemma4")]
163	        │
164	        ▼  model_lines() 的注册向量里多出 &pegainfer_gemma4::model_line::MODEL_LINE
165	```
166	
167	注意两种写法的区别：`qwen3 = ["dep:pegainfer-qwen3"]` 只拉依赖；而 `gemma4`、`glm52`、`k3`、`kimi-k2`、`qwen35`、`deepseek-v2-lite` 都带第二项转发。原因是这些模型 crate 把自己的实现藏在 crate 内部的同名 feature 之后（比如构建期的 AOT kernel 生成按 feature 触发），server 必须转发激活；而 `pegainfer-qwen3` 的 `[features]` 里只有诊断类开关（`kernel-call-trace`、`kernel-report`），没有 `qwen3` feature，编译即全量，所以只拉依赖就够。

220	### 4.3 main.rs：纯分发二进制的自我描述与 model_lines()
221	
222	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
223	
224	`src/main.rs` 开头的模块文档（module doc）是全文件的设计宣言：
225	
226	```rust
227	//! The pegainfer server binary: pure dispatch over the compiled-in
228	//! [`ModelLine`]s. Every model-specific flag, rule, and option type lives in
229	//! its model crate; this file only wires detection, CLI validation, and the
230	//! serve path selection together.
231	```
232	
233	译成中文：**pegainfer server 二进制是对「已编译进的各条 ModelLine」的纯分发。所有模型专属的 flag、规则和选项类型都住在各自的模型 crate 里；本文件只把检测、CLI 校验和服务路径选择接线到一起。**
234	
235	「纯分发（pure dispatch）」的含义值得咀嚼：
236	
237	- server 持有的只是 `&'static dyn ModelLine`（trait 对象的静态引用）——它不知道也不关心某条线的选项具体长什么样。
238	- 新增一条模型线，对 server 的改动只是：加一个 Cargo feature、在 `model_lines()` 里加一行（可选地在 `families()` 加一行身份表）。
239	- 所有的「智能」都在别处：检测规则在模型 crate 的 `probe`，CLI 规则在 `augment_cli`/`validate`，引擎启动在 `launch`。
240	
241	对初学者补充一句：`&'static dyn ModelLine` 里的 `dyn` 表示「编译期不锁定具体类型、运行时按 vtable 分发」；`'static` 表示这些对象以静态量形式存在于各模型 crate 里（如 `pegainfer_qwen3::model_line::MODEL_LINE`），进程全生命周期有效。
242	
243	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
244	
245	`main()` 的启动主流程全景（本讲只建立骨架，逐段精读在 u1-l3）：
246	
247	```text
248	main()
249	 ├── logging/tracing 初始化
250	 ├── ModelLineRegistry::new(model_lines())        ← 把已编译的线装进注册表
251	 ├── registry.build_command(...) + get_matches()  ← 合并共享 CLI 与各线独占 flag
252	 ├── 读 <model-path>/config.json
253	 ├── registry.detect(&config)                     ← 恰好一条线认领才算成功
254	 │      └─ NoMatch 时尝试 feature_gate_hint 提示「rebuild with --features xxx」
255	 ├── registry.validate_provided(...) + shared.validate(...) + line.validate(...)
256	 ├── line.serve_plan(&ctx)                        ← 引擎加载前就需要知道的服务形态
257	 ├── tokio::task::spawn_blocking(line.launch)     ← 引擎加载与 HTTP 前端并行
258	 └── 按 plan 选 serve 分支：
259	       ├── lora_modules 有值 → serve_model_with_lora_routes（要求 Stepped 引擎）
260	       ├── prefill_only      → serve_prefill_only_with_engine_count
261	       └── 默认              → serve_with_engine_count
262	```

264	本模块聚焦第一步的 `model_lines()`，以及为「被编译掉的线」服务的 `families()` 身份表。

340	**答案**：那么每条线都会成为**非可选**依赖（否则编译不过），任何构建都得拉齐 8 个模型 crate 及其构建期工具链（Triton/TileLang/额外 CUDA 源码）——「默认构建纯 Rust 无 Python」的性质就被破坏了。cfg 守卫与 optional 依赖是一对搭档。
341	
342	**练习 2**：`families()` 的文档说自己是「a second source of truth by necessity」。既然是第二真相源，项目如何防止它与模型 crate 里的真实身份漂移？
343	
344	**答案**：用测试钉住。qwen4 行有专门的绑定测试 `qwen4_hint_identity_matches_the_line_crate`（[src/main.rs:324-337](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L324-L337)，仅在 `qwen4` feature 开启时编译），把 `families()` 里的 `model_types`/`text_model_types` 与 `pegainfer_qwen4::MODEL_TYPE`/`TEXT_MODEL_TYPE` 常量逐一比对——改了任何一边，另一边不改就测试失败。
345	
346	**练习 3**：一个用户拿着 `model_type: "qwen3"` 的**量化变体** checkpoint（probe 会拒绝的那种）在默认构建下启动，`feature_gate_hint` 会沉默吗？这是 bug 吗？
347	
348	**答案**：会沉默——qwen3 已编译（`compiled == true`），提示只在「未编译」时触发；接下来 `registry.detect` 里已编译的 qwen3 线的 `probe` 会运行并给出它自己的拒绝理由（量化配置不支持等）。反过来，如果拿一个被编译掉的线的量化变体（如 glm52 的量化版）来跑，提示**会**触发，尽管 rebuild 后 probe 仍会拒绝——文档明说提示是 identity-only，「it is not a promise that the checkpoint is servable」。所以两种行为都是设计内的。
349	
350	## 5. 综合实践
351	
352	**任务：制作一份《pegainfer-server 构建形态核对报告》，把本讲三个模块串起来。**
353	
354	1. **文档面**：从 [../README.md:142-156](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/README.md#L142-L156) 的受支持模型表抄下 7 条线及其 feature 名。
355	2. **代码面**：从 [Cargo.toml:34-48](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/Cargo.toml#L34-L48) 与 [src/main.rs:67-118](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L67-L118) 补齐第 8 条线（qwen4）。
356	3. **三方核对**：回答并记录三个差异点——
357	   - README 表（7 行）与 Cargo features（8 个）差在哪一行？
358	   - 8 个 feature 里，哪几个除了 `dep:` 之外还向模型 crate 转发了同名 feature？为什么 qwen3/qwen4 不需要？
359	   - 默认构建下 `families()` 的 8 个 `compiled` 字段各是什么？
360	4. **（可选，需 GPU 机器）实测**：`cargo run --release -- --help` 后，从帮助文本里挑出 3 个 flag，分别归类为「共享 flag」或「qwen3 独占 flag」，并在源码里找到它们的定义位置线索（共享 flag 在 `pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs` 的 `SharedArgs`，独占 flag 在 `pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs`）。
361	
362	**预期产出**：一页报告，能回答「这个二进制是怎么按 feature 裁剪的、裁掉之后检测提示靠什么工作」。如果全程无 GPU 环境，第 4 步标注「待本地验证」，前三步纯静态阅读即可完成。
363	
364	## 6. 本讲小结
365	
366	- PegaInfer 是纯 Rust + CUDA 的 LLM 推理引擎，对外提供 OpenAI 兼容 `/v1` API；设计原则是「共享基础设施，每个模型拥有自己的执行」。
367	- 架构分层：server（装配）→ frontend（协议/分词/模板/流式/引擎契约）→ 模型 crate（调度与执行）→ core/kernels（GPU 原语与 kernel）→ KV 基础设施；请求沿这条链路自上而下流动。
368	- pegainfer-server 是约 300 行的**纯分发**二进制：模块文档自述「every model-specific flag, rule, and option type lives in its model crate」，它只做检测、CLI 校验与服务路径选择。
369	- Cargo feature 矩阵决定二进制内容：`default = ["qwen3"]` 保证 stock 构建纯 Rust 无 Python；其余 7 条线经 `--features` 拉入，部分 feature 还要向模型 crate 转发以触发其内部门控实现。
370	- `model_lines()`（cfg 守卫的注册向量）与 `families()`（含 `compiled` 字段的身份表）是 feature 矩阵在代码里的映照；后者是「必要的第二真相源」，专为被编译掉的线提供 rebuild 提示。
371	- 观察到一处文档/代码错位：README 受支持模型表列 7 条线，代码里有 8 个 feature（`qwen4` 为实验线）——读源码时要习惯用代码核对文档。
372	
373	## 7. 下一步学习建议
374	
375	- **下一讲（u1-l2）**：构建与运行——为什么 GPU 构建必须 `--release`、jemallocator 全局分配器、用 `cargo tree` 与 `--version` 验证 feature 构建假设。
376	- **随后（u1-l3）**：逐段精读 `main()` 从 CLI 到 serve 的完整启动主流程（本讲 4.3.2 的流程图会在那一讲展开到每一行）。
377	- **延伸阅读源码**（为第二、三单元做准备）：`../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs`（`ModelLine` trait 与注册表定义）——可以先只看 `trait ModelLine` 的方法签名，感受「server 只依赖这一个接缝」。

# 项目定位与架构地图：pegainfer-server 是什么

> 学习阶段：入门（beginner）· 依赖：无（这是本手册的第一篇）

## 1. 本讲目标

读完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 用两三句话说清 **PegaInfer** 的定位：一个纯 Rust + CUDA 的 LLM 推理引擎，对外提供 OpenAI 兼容的 `/v1` HTTP API，不依赖 PyTorch 或 Python 运行时。
2. 说清 **pegainfer-server** 这个 crate 在整个工作区里的职责：它只是一个约 300 行的「纯分发」二进制——检测模型、校验 CLI、启动所选引擎、把服务交给前端，**不含任何模型逻辑**。
3. 对照 README 的架构边界表，指出 server / frontend / 模型 crate / core+kernels / KV 基础设施各层分别负责什么，以及一条请求大致穿过哪些层。
4. 解释 Cargo 的 **feature 矩阵**如何决定「这个二进制里编译进了哪几条模型线」，并知道默认构建只带 `qwen3`。

本讲不要求你写过 Rust 大型工程，但需要你能在终端里执行 `cargo` 命令、能读懂基本的 Rust 语法。

## 2. 前置知识

用通俗语言把几个基础概念先铺平：

- **LLM 推理引擎（inference engine）**：加载模型权重到 GPU，接收文本请求，逐个生成 token 并返回的服务程序。生成分两个阶段：**prefill**（把输入 prompt 一次性算完）和 **decode**（逐 token 生成）。引擎的核心工作是调度这两类计算、管理 KV 缓存。
- **OpenAI 兼容 API**：指暴露 `/v1/completions`、`/v1/chat/completions` 这类路由，请求/响应格式与 OpenAI 官方 API 一致。这样任何 OpenAI 客户端 SDK 指向本服务即可使用，无需改造。
- **Cargo workspace 与 crate**：一个仓库（repo）里可以放多个 Rust 包（crate），由根目录的 `Cargo.toml` 统一管理依赖版本。本仓库就是一个 workspace，`pegainfer-server` 是其中之一。
- **Cargo feature**：编译期的「开关」。crate 可以把一部分代码（甚至一部分依赖）藏在 feature 后面，只有 `--features xxx` 构建时才编译进来。本项目的每条模型线就是一个 feature。
- **纯 Rust + CUDA**：模型的算子直接用 Rust 绑定 CUDA/cuBLAS/FlashInfer 等原生库实现，构建期不需要 Python（个别模型线的构建期 AOT kernel 生成除外）。
- **ModelLine（模型线）**：本项目术语，指一类模型（如 Qwen3、Gemma 4）对应的完整实现 crate，包含配置解析、权重加载、调度器与执行。server 二进制通过一个统一的 trait（`ModelLine`）与它们对话——这个 trait 是第二单元的主角，本讲先只要知道它的存在。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

本讲涉及的关键文件（路径相对 `pegainfer-server/` 目录，与文末永久链接一致）：

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [../README.md](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/README.md) | 工作区根 README：项目定位、快速开始、受支持模型表、**架构边界表**（本讲的地图来源） |
| [Cargo.toml](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/Cargo.toml) | server crate 的清单：二进制名、**feature 矩阵**、可选依赖 |
| [src/main.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs) | 整个二进制的唯一源码文件：模块文档（自我定位）、`model_lines()` 注册表、`families()` 身份表、`main()` 启动流程 |
| [../Cargo.toml](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/Cargo.toml) | 工作区根清单：`default-members = ["pegainfer-server"]`，解释了为什么在仓库根直接 `cargo run` 就能跑 server |

pegainfer-server 这个 crate 小得惊人：`src/` 下只有一个 `main.rs`（338 行，其中约 50 行是测试），外加一个集成测试 `tests/detect_gate.rs`。**它的全部实质内容都在它引用的 `pegainfer-frontend` 契约里**——这正是本手册以 server 为锚点、逐步深入 frontend 的原因。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 PegaInfer 全景：定位与分层架构（README 架构章节）

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

先建立全局观。PegaInfer 是什么？README 开篇一句话给出定位：

> PegaInfer serves LLMs through an OpenAI-compatible API. Each model owns its scheduler, state, and kernels; serving and KV infrastructure are shared. No PyTorch or Python runtime.

翻译过来有三层信息：

1. **对外**：OpenAI 兼容 API，监听 8000 端口（`pegainfer --model-path models/Qwen3-4B` 即可起服务）。
2. **对内**：设计原则是「**共享基础设施；让每个模型拥有自己的执行**」（README 原文：Share the infrastructure; let each model own its execution）。每条模型线自带调度器、状态与 kernel；协议栈、分词、KV 存储这些跨模型的能力则共享。
3. **技术栈**：纯 Rust + CUDA，无 PyTorch、无 Python 运行时（注意：前端复用了 vLLM 的 **Rust** 前端 crate，这与「基于 vLLM/Python」是两回事）。

在这张地图里，pegainfer-server 处在**最外缘的装配位置**：它不实现协议、不实现模型，只负责「把正确的引擎装配起来交给前端」。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

一条 HTTP 请求的生命周期（本讲只看分层，不看细节）：

```text
OpenAI 客户端（curl / openai SDK）
        │  HTTP POST /v1/completions 或 /v1/chat/completions
        ▼
pegainfer-frontend ── OpenAI 协议、分词(tokenization)、chat 模板、流式、指标
        │  引擎契约（engine contract：请求/事件的数据类型约定）
        ▼
模型 crate（如 pegainfer-qwen3）── 权重、调度器、prefill/decode 执行、并行策略
        │
        ├── pegainfer-core / pegainfer-sample ── 共享 GPU 原语、权重加载、批量采样
        ├── pegainfer-kernels ── 原生 kernel、FFI、GPU 库接入、feature 门控的 AOT 构建
        └── KV 基础设施 ── pegainfer-kv-store / kv-cache / kv-offload，PegaFlow 提供 host/SSD/RDMA 分层
```

而 server 在这条链路的**上游**，负责启动时刻的装配：

```text
CLI 参数（--model-path 等）
        ▼
pegainfer-server：读 config.json → 检测模型家族 → 校验 CLI → 启动引擎 → 选择 serve 分支
        ▼
pegainfer-frontend 的 serve 函数：起 HTTP 服务，把请求喂给引擎
```

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**① 项目定位句** —— [../README.md:31](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/README.md#L31)：这一行就是 PegaInfer 的「一句话自我介绍」，本节开头的引文即出自此处。

**② 受支持模型表** —— [../README.md:142-156](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/README.md#L142-L156)：README 明确说「Only `qwen3` is enabled by default... At launch, `--model-path` selects a checkpoint and its `config.json` identifies the model family」——即启动时靠模型目录里的 `config.json` 识别家族（这正是 server 的检测门要做的事，详见 u1-l4）。表格列出 7 条模型线（qwen3、qwen35、gemma4、deepseek-v2-lite、kimi-k2、glm52、k3）各自的 feature 名与能力范围。**注意：这张表是 7 行，而代码里的 feature 有 8 个——多出来的 `qwen4` 是实验线（`model_type` 为 `qwen4_exp`），尚未列入 README 的受支持模型表**。这种「文档与代码的错位」在真实项目里很常见，也是本讲综合实践要你亲手核对的点。

**③ 架构边界表（本讲最重要的表）** —— [../README.md:158-181](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/README.md#L158-L181)：README 用一张所有权分层图加一张边界表描述架构。表的内容整理如下：

| 边界 | 职责（README 原文的中文转述） |
| --- | --- |
| `pegainfer-server` | **检测模型、校验其 CLI、启动所选引擎**——仅此三件事 |
| `pegainfer-frontend` | OpenAI 协议、分词、chat 模板、流式、指标，以及**引擎契约**；复用 vLLM 的 Rust 前端 crate |
| 各模型 crate | 权重、调度器、prefill/decode 执行、状态布局、并行策略 |
| `pegainfer-core` / `pegainfer-sample` | 共享 GPU 与权重加载原语；批量 token 采样 |
| `pegainfer-kernels` | 原生 kernel、FFI、GPU 库接入、feature 门控的 AOT 构建 |
| KV 基础设施 | `pegainfer-kv-store` 与 `pegainfer-kv-cache` / `pegainfer-kv-offload`；PegaFlow 提供 host/SSD/RDMA 存储与传输 |

**④ 契约共存说明** —— [../README.md:182](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/README.md#L182)：README 坦率说明「基于 step 的契约与 legacy `EngineHandle` 契约当前并存」。本讲只需记住这个事实；两代契约的完整地图是第三单元（u3-l1）的内容。

**⑤ API 示例** —— [../README.md:184-196](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/README.md#L184-L196)：给出了 `/v1/completions` 与流式 `/v1/chat/completions` 的 curl 示例。服务跑起来后可以用这两条命令验证。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：把 README 的架构边界表「落地」成你机器上真实可见的目录。

**操作步骤**：

1. 在仓库根目录执行 `ls`，对照边界表逐层找目录：`pegainfer-server`、`pegainfer-frontend`、`pegainfer-core`、`pegainfer-kernels`、`pegainfer-kv-store`、以及各模型 crate（`pegainfer-qwen3`、`pegainfer-gemma4`……）。
2. 再 `ls pegainfer-server`，亲眼确认这个 crate 只有一个 `Cargo.toml`、`src/main.rs`、`tests/detect_gate.rs`。
3. 打开根目录 `Cargo.toml`，找到 `default-members = ["pegainfer-server"]`（[../Cargo.toml:2](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/Cargo.toml#L2)）。

**需要观察的现象**：README 表里的每个「边界」都对应一个真实存在的成员 crate 目录；pegainfer-server 是其中最薄的一个。

**预期结果**：你能在不翻代码的情况下说出「HTTP 层在哪、模型逻辑在哪、GPU 原语在哪」。同时解释一个疑问：为什么 README 说「The server entrypoint is `pegainfer-server`」，而快速开始里直接 `cargo run --release -- --model-path ...` 就行？——因为 workspace 的 `default-members` 只含 `pegainfer-server`，在仓库根裸跑 `cargo run` 时 cargo 知道该跑谁。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：PegaInfer 说自己「No PyTorch or Python runtime」，但前端又「uses vLLM's Rust frontend crates」，这两句话矛盾吗？

**答案**：不矛盾。vLLM 项目里有一批纯 Rust 写的前端 crate（协议处理等），PegaInfer 复用的是这批 **Rust** 代码；它没有引入 vLLM 的 Python 推理栈。构建出的二进制不携带 Python 解释器（`qwen35` 等线在**构建期**需要 Python + Triton 做 AOT kernel 生成，但那是编译工具链，不是运行时依赖）。

**练习 2**：一个 `/v1/chat/completions` 请求的 chat 模板渲染、流式输出分别由哪一层负责？

**答案**：都是 `pegainfer-frontend`（README 边界表：「OpenAI protocol, tokenization, chat templates, streaming, metrics, and engine contracts」）。模型 crate 只见 token，不见 HTTP。

**练习 3**：如果把「读取 `config.json` 判断模型家族」这段逻辑实现在某个模型 crate 里，为什么不合理？

**答案**：因为判断「这是哪条线」发生在选择模型 crate **之前**——必须先识别家族，才知道要加载哪个 crate 的实现。所以检测逻辑只能放在所有模型线之外、且能同时看到所有已编译线的地方，即 server 的注册表（`ModelLineRegistry`）。这也是下一模块 feature 矩阵存在的意义：被编译掉的线根本不参与检测。

### 4.2 feature 矩阵：Cargo.toml 如何决定二进制里有哪些模型线

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

一个关键问题：**为什么不是所有模型都编译进同一个二进制？**

因为模型线的成本差异巨大：`qwen3` 是纯 Rust + CUDA，构建无需 Python；而 `qwen35` 需要构建期跑 Triton AOT（要装 Python + Triton），`glm52`/`k3` 需要 TileLang 生成 kernel，`kimi-k2`/`glm52` 还要额外的 CUDA 源码。把所有线无条件编译，意味着「只想跑 Qwen3 的用户」也得配齐整套工具链。

Cargo 的 feature + optional dependency 机制正好解决这个问题：

- 在 `[dependencies]` 里把各模型 crate 声明为 `optional = true`——默认不编译。
- 在 `[features]` 里为每条线开一个同名开关，开关激活时用 `dep:pegainfer-xxx` 把可选依赖「点亮」。
- `default = ["qwen3"]` 让默认构建只带 Qwen3，其他线按需 `--features` 拉入。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

feature 激活的传导链：

```text
cargo build --features gemma4
        │
        ▼  Cargo.toml [features]：gemma4 = ["dep:pegainfer-gemma4", "pegainfer-gemma4/gemma4"]
        │
        ├── dep:pegainfer-gemma4          → 可选依赖被点亮，模型 crate 参与编译
        └── pegainfer-gemma4/gemma4       → 把同名 feature 转发进模型 crate 内部，
                                            激活其内部门控的实现（kernel、构建脚本产物等）
        │
        ▼  src/main.rs 里 #[cfg(feature = "gemma4")]
        │
        ▼  model_lines() 的注册向量里多出 &pegainfer_gemma4::model_line::MODEL_LINE
```

注意两种写法的区别：`qwen3 = ["dep:pegainfer-qwen3"]` 只拉依赖；而 `gemma4`、`glm52`、`k3`、`kimi-k2`、`qwen35`、`deepseek-v2-lite` 都带第二项转发。原因是这些模型 crate 把自己的实现藏在 crate 内部的同名 feature 之后（比如构建期的 AOT kernel 生成按 feature 触发），server 必须转发激活；而 `pegainfer-qwen3` 的 `[features]` 里只有诊断类开关（`kernel-call-trace`、`kernel-report`），没有 `qwen3` feature，编译即全量，所以只拉依赖就够。

### 4.3 main.rs：纯分发二进制的自我描述与 model_lines()

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`src/main.rs` 开头的模块文档（module doc）是全文件的设计宣言：

```rust
//! The pegainfer server binary: pure dispatch over the compiled-in
//! [`ModelLine`]s. Every model-specific flag, rule, and option type lives in
//! its model crate; this file only wires detection, CLI validation, and the
//! serve path selection together.
```

译成中文：**pegainfer server 二进制是对「已编译进的各条 ModelLine」的纯分发。所有模型专属的 flag、规则和选项类型都住在各自的模型 crate 里；本文件只把检测、CLI 校验和服务路径选择接线到一起。**

「纯分发（pure dispatch）」的含义值得咀嚼：

- server 持有的只是 `&'static dyn ModelLine`（trait 对象的静态引用）——它不知道也不关心某条线的选项具体长什么样。
- 新增一条模型线，对 server 的改动只是：加一个 Cargo feature、在 `model_lines()` 里加一行（可选地在 `families()` 加一行身份表）。
- 所有的「智能」都在别处：检测规则在模型 crate 的 `probe`，CLI 规则在 `augment_cli`/`validate`，引擎启动在 `launch`。

对初学者补充一句：`&'static dyn ModelLine` 里的 `dyn` 表示「编译期不锁定具体类型、运行时按 vtable 分发」；`'static` 表示这些对象以静态量形式存在于各模型 crate 里（如 `pegainfer_qwen3::model_line::MODEL_LINE`），进程全生命周期有效。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

`main()` 的启动主流程全景（本讲只建立骨架，逐段精读在 u1-l3）：

```text
main()
 ├── logging/tracing 初始化
 ├── ModelLineRegistry::new(model_lines())        ← 把已编译的线装进注册表
 ├── registry.build_command(...) + get_matches()  ← 合并共享 CLI 与各线独占 flag
 ├── 读 <model-path>/config.json
 ├── registry.detect(&config)                     ← 恰好一条线认领才算成功
 │      └─ NoMatch 时尝试 feature_gate_hint 提示「rebuild with --features xxx」
 ├── registry.validate_provided(...) + shared.validate(...) + line.validate(...)
 ├── line.serve_plan(&ctx)                        ← 引擎加载前就需要知道的服务形态
 ├── tokio::task::spawn_blocking(line.launch)     ← 引擎加载与 HTTP 前端并行
 └── 按 plan 选 serve 分支：
       ├── lora_modules 有值 → serve_model_with_lora_routes（要求 Stepped 引擎）
       ├── prefill_only      → serve_prefill_only_with_engine_count
       └── 默认              → serve_with_engine_count
```

本模块聚焦第一步的 `model_lines()`，以及为「被编译掉的线」服务的 `families()` 身份表。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**① 模块文档** —— [src/main.rs:1-4](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L1-L4)：「纯分发」的自我定位，4.3.1 已全文引用。

**② 全局分配器** —— [src/main.rs:20-22](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L20-L22)：非 msvc 平台把 jemalloc 声明为全局分配器（LLM 推理服务大量分配释放张量元数据与缓冲，jemalloc 的碎片控制优于系统分配器）。这三行是性能基建，与分发逻辑无关，但属于「为什么这个二进制快」的一部分。

**③ `model_lines()`：注册表的内容清单** —— [src/main.rs:24-43](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L24-L43)：

```rust
fn model_lines() -> Vec<&'static dyn ModelLine> {
    vec![
        #[cfg(feature = "deepseek-v2-lite")]
        &pegainfer_deepseek_v2_lite::model_line::MODEL_LINE,
        #[cfg(feature = "gemma4")]
        &pegainfer_gemma4::model_line::MODEL_LINE,
        // ... glm52 / k3 / kimi-k2 ...
        #[cfg(feature = "qwen3")]
        &pegainfer_qwen3::model_line::MODEL_LINE,
        // ... qwen35 / qwen4 ...
    ]
}
```

每个元素都是「一个 `#[cfg]` 守卫 + 一条线的静态 MODEL_LINE」。**这个函数就是 4.2 的 feature 矩阵在代码里的直接映照**：feature 关 → 该行被 cfg 掉 → 该线不参与检测与注册。默认构建下这个 `vec!` 只剩 qwen3 一项。

**④ `families()`：必要的第二真相源** —— [src/main.rs:54-118](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L54-L118)：一张硬编码的身份表，每行 `Family { feature, model_types, text_model_types, compiled }`，其中 `compiled: cfg!(feature = ...)` 在编译期求值。为什么需要它？文档注释说得很直白（[src/main.rs:56-60](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L56-L60)）：**提示存在的意义恰恰是针对「线被编译掉」的情形——线都被编译掉了，它的 `probe` 根本无法运行，身份字符串不可能从该 crate 读出**，只能硬编码在 server 里。它配合 `feature_gate_hint`（[src/main.rs:120-144](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L120-L144)）在检测失败时给出「this looks like a glm52 model; rebuild pegainfer-server with --features glm52」这样的建议。注意文档同时声明该提示是 **identity-only**：它只看 `model_type` 字符串，不校验量化配置、绑定嵌入、YaRN 等变体细节，所以提示「rebuild with」不代表 checkpoint 一定可服务。文件尾部的测试（[src/main.rs:291-338](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L291-L338)）逐一守护这些性质，例如 `hint_names_the_feature_for_a_known_but_uncompiled_family` 断言 `{"model_type": "glm_moe_dsa"}` 在未编译 glm52 时产出含 `--features glm52` 的提示。

**⑤ `main()` 骨架** —— [src/main.rs:146-186](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L146-L186)：从注册表构建到 `serve_plan` 的前半段，正是 4.3.2 流程图的前七行。留意 [src/main.rs:168-175](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L168-L175)：`detect` 失败时若是 `NoMatch`，会尝试用 `feature_gate_hint` 把提示拼进错误信息再返回给用户——这就是「检测门 + feature 提示」的完整体验，u1-l4 会用真实二进制驱动它。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`model_lines()` 里如果没有 `#[cfg(feature = ...)]` 守卫会发生什么？

**答案**：那么每条线都会成为**非可选**依赖（否则编译不过），任何构建都得拉齐 8 个模型 crate 及其构建期工具链（Triton/TileLang/额外 CUDA 源码）——「默认构建纯 Rust 无 Python」的性质就被破坏了。cfg 守卫与 optional 依赖是一对搭档。

**练习 2**：`families()` 的文档说自己是「a second source of truth by necessity」。既然是第二真相源，项目如何防止它与模型 crate 里的真实身份漂移？

**答案**：用测试钉住。qwen4 行有专门的绑定测试 `qwen4_hint_identity_matches_the_line_crate`（[src/main.rs:324-337](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L324-L337)，仅在 `qwen4` feature 开启时编译），把 `families()` 里的 `model_types`/`text_model_types` 与 `pegainfer_qwen4::MODEL_TYPE`/`TEXT_MODEL_TYPE` 常量逐一比对——改了任何一边，另一边不改就测试失败。

**练习 3**：一个用户拿着 `model_type: "qwen3"` 的**量化变体** checkpoint（probe 会拒绝的那种）在默认构建下启动，`feature_gate_hint` 会沉默吗？这是 bug 吗？

**答案**：会沉默——qwen3 已编译（`compiled == true`），提示只在「未编译」时触发；接下来 `registry.detect` 里已编译的 qwen3 线的 `probe` 会运行并给出它自己的拒绝理由（量化配置不支持等）。反过来，如果拿一个被编译掉的线的量化变体（如 glm52 的量化版）来跑，提示**会**触发，尽管 rebuild 后 probe 仍会拒绝——文档明说提示是 identity-only，「it is not a promise that the checkpoint is servable」。所以两种行为都是设计内的。

    ))
